name: av_lin_unknown_block
source:
{ LINEARIZE naming a DYNAMIC block that does not exist. }
Q_in = 1000
HeatSource    HS(Q = Q_in)
ThermalMass   M(C = 5000, T0 = 300)
ThermalSource amb(T = 300)
connect(HS.port, M.port, amb.port)
DYNAMIC warmup(time = 0 .. 1)
END
LINEARIZE plant(block = nosuchblock, a = A, b = B, c = C, d = D)
  INPUT  Q_in
  OUTPUT m.port.T
END

error.message: LINEARIZE plant: no DYNAMIC block named 'nosuchblock' (it names the transient component network to linearize).
